title: Playing occasional spot jobs
summary: He still plays spot jobs when friends like Johnny McGee need a trumpet.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Uh-huh. But you have, uh, contacts with them for playing music? Go out in the country much?
You never did? Oh, you mean from when I played music? Yeah.
I didn't know any of these people. Well, you played jobs since you come back some once in a while.

Oh, yeah. I played spot jobs. Like the job I was telling you, I played at the lake there. Uh-huh. Johnny McGee needed a trumpet man. Yeah. He come got me and, you know. I still do it. Fellas that I know are getting a spot where they need a man. I'd go, go with him. Not that I'm that great, you know what I mean? But if that guy get in a spot, he needs a man, he needs a man. Especially in non-union, it's hard to find too many non-union men. Most of them are in the union. Hard to find a good lead, didn't it?
